Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 22

“Content with whatever comes unsought, beyond dualities, free of envy, the same in success and failure — such a one, though acting, is not bound.”

Contentment with the unsought returns from Chapter 2, but envy is new. Krishna notices that measuring oneself against others is a separate chain from wanting outcomes.
